meta.scope: Facility-reported emissions of permitted/registered installations 2019-2025; NOT the national emission inventory.
meta.provenance: Operator-declared annual reports; calculation methods are mixed (system-calculated, calculated, measured). No QC level is stated and none is assumed.

units.heat_electricity: MWh (assumed; not in schema, inferred from fuel energy)

limits: The number of reporting installations changes between years; totals are not a complete or constant population.
Only 2019-2025: no long-term trend; 7 points carry no significance test.
Rows that share report, source, substance and fuel are kept as reported; the sensitivity block shows how much would change without them.

heat.rule: heat/fuel outside 0.1x..10.0x of the fuel's median ratio, or heat without fuel

climate_link.note: Seven points at most: shown for orientation only, no statistic is computed.
